road_field.method: Rigid source blocks: translation only. Nearest retained-patch anchors outside retained patches is used for labels, never to scale blocks.
road_field.scope: Jacobian statement applies to retained rigid patches only.

notes: Valencia mesh is orientation-checked; exterior road grade separation and navigation remain to be reviewed.
Old Turia bed is a dry urban park. New southern floodway is separate.
Building footprints are 1:1; heights without source measurements are previews.

corridor_details.method: Contract long straights more than bends; preserve turn angles at retained OSM vertices
OSM corridor with shared northward valley adjustment, up to450m centrally; west approach and port outlet remain fixed.
Contract long straights more than bends; preserve turn angles at retained OSM vertices
Same longitudinal airport compaction; preserve geographic relationship A-3 / V-11 / runway, rather than independently fitting this road.
Contract long straights more than bends; preserve turn angles at retained OSM vertices

mesh.method: Whole OSM blocks translated at 1:1; Delaunay building mesh + shared avenue nodes; full-size landmark ensembles bulge locally. Remove ordinary blocks rather than fold the displacement mesh.
mesh.scope: Metric footprint and planar geometry checks. No certified heights, driving restrictions or hydraulic simulation. Signed side at a short OSM way endpoint needs manual interpretation.
